title: Liberia Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Observed rainfall impacts in 2020; flood exposure and climate projections through 2050 and 2064
methodology: CCDR combines climate-risk assessment with development analysis and climate scenarios.
limitations: Detailed flood assessment is available only for Greater Monrovia; national baseline climate-hazard data are limited.

title: Liberia’s Third Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0): Liberia’s 2035 Nationally Determined Contribution
organization: Republic of Liberia; submitted to the UNFCCC
methodology: Government NDC summarizes national vulnerability and planned sector adaptation targets.
limitations: Targets describe intended actions, not evaluated implementation or outcomes.
